title: Cutting FFPE Sections for Imaging Mass Cytometry
author: Marda Jorgensen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfz4jp8w

steps.title: Cool FFPE block to 4 °C
steps.instruction: Switch on the FFPE block cooling device, set the temperature to 4 °C, and place the FFPE block inside the device.

steps.title: Set up microtome and water bath
steps.instruction: Connect the microtome cooling unit cable and turn it on at the front; switch on the microtome using the back button; install the water bath with its filter; add deionised water until the grid is slightly covered; place a fresh blade in the blade holder; verify water flow and, if absent, rinse the tubing with a syringe of water; set water flow to 3 or 4; fix the precooled FFPE block in the specimen clamp holder; unlock the clamping lever and adjust orienting screws to set the blade‑block angle; set trimming (Trim) thickness by pressing the top knob once and cutting (Feed) thickness by pressing it twice; unlock the wheel using the mechanical hand‑wheel brake on the right‑hand side beneath the wheel.

steps.title: Warm stretching table to 37 °C
steps.instruction: Switch on the stretching table and set its temperature to 37 °C.

steps.title: Trim tissue with fresh blade
steps.instruction: Use a new sharp blade to trim the block carefully, readjust the cutting angle if needed, and after each trim take up a cut and examine it under a microscope; exchange the water bath before beginning to cut sections you intend to collect.

steps.title: Cut sections and collect on slides
steps.instruction: Cut the tissue with a uniform gentle rotation, allowing the cut to slide into the water bath; wait until the section flattens before lifting it onto a glass slide; dry the bottom side of the slide before placing it on the stretcher; exchange water regularly if paraffin debris accumulates and between samples.

steps.title: Shut down microtome and clean
steps.instruction: Block the wheel immediately after cutting to prevent injury; dispose of the blade; turn the water‑flow wheel down to 0 to stop flow; discard the water and clean the water bath, filter, and grid, then set them aside to dry; clean the water slide and the microtome of paraffin debris; switch off the microtome at the back and disconnect its cooling block; finally, switch off the FFPE block cooling device.

steps.title: Dry sections at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Dry the collected sections either overnight or for 1–2 hours at 37 °C, avoiding longer drying times.

steps.title: Store sections at –80 °C
steps.instruction: Store all freshly cut and dried sections at –80 °C, or proceed to staining within one week.
